name: GhostButton
description: Headless native action control. useGhostButton owns behavior; GhostButton is the thin unstyled element. Themed visual props live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Applies native disabled semantics, prevents activation, and removes the button from sequential focus order.

props.name: loading
props.description: Consumer-owned pending state. Prevents activation while remaining focusable, sets aria-disabled and aria-busy, and preserves slot content so the accessible name does not change.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button behavior. Defaults to button so a control inside a form does not submit unless the consumer opts in.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Button label and optional decorative content such as an icon. Icon-only use requires aria-label, aria-labelledby, or hidden text.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the native button when it is mounted. No-op before mount.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native button after mount; null before mount and after unmount.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the native button when it is mounted and enabled. No-op before mount.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: Optional decorative icon content inside the default slot.

parts.name: loading-indicator
parts.description: Optional decorative pending indicator inside the default slot. Replaces the themed default spinner when present.

states.name: loading
states.description: Pending action. Used when native disabled is the wrong focus model. Wins over disabled when both props are true.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable action. Prefer the native disabled attribute when both apply. Omitted while loading.

keyboard.Enter: Activate the button when it is enabled and not loading.
keyboard.Space: Activate the button when it is enabled and not loading.
